# statusdrift_alert (Resource)

Represents a StatusDrift alert. Alerts are read-only and managed through the statusdrift_monitor resource's alert block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alerts are managed through the statusdrift_monitor resource's alert block.
# Use the statusdrift_alert data source to read existing alerts.

data "statusdrift_monitor" "example" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (List of String) List of conditions that trigger this alert. Valid values: up, down, warning, domain_expiry, cert_expiry, mixed_content, whois_change.
- `monitor_id` (Number) The ID of the monitor this alert belongs to.
- `notification_channel_ids` (List of Number) List of notification channel IDs to notify when this alert triggers.

### Optional

- `delay_minutes` (Number) Number of minutes to delay before sending the alert.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this alert is enabled.
- `max_recurrences` (Number) Maximum number of recurring notifications to send.
- `recurring_interval_minutes` (Number) Interval in minutes between recurring alert notifications.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the alert.
- `notify_on_call` (Boolean) Whether this alert triggers the on-call escalation policy.
- `on_call_policy_id` (Number) On-call policy ID used for this alert.
